prospective_policy.status: New construction policy; not claimed to reproduce the paper normalization or metric
prospective_policy.dimensions: Original neuron identities, all 72 owner-mapped stimulus conditions, 15 owner-declared sample centers, both A and F
prospective_policy.normalization: Train-only per-neuron population variance with equal condition weight; zero scale is an error
prospective_policy.aggregation: Time mean, within-condition assessment-trial mean, 72-condition mean, original-unit mean within monkey, equal A/F mean
prospective_policy.minimum_partition: At least 2 train, 1 validation, 1 assessment correct trials per eligible unit and condition
prospective_policy.eligible: At least 4 correct trials in each of all 72 conditions; no candidate unit exclusion flag
prospective_policy.selection: Owner-declared trial split and frozen program artifact; byte identity alone does not prove protected execution
